title: Baptism
definition: Baptism is the Christian ordinance in which a believer is marked publicly with water in the name of the Father, Son, and Holy Spirit, signifying union with Christ, cleansing, and identification with His people.
summary: Baptism does not replace faith in Christ, but it visibly declares the Gospel realities of death, burial, resurrection, cleansing, and discipleship.
christFocus: Baptism points to Christ’s saving work and the believer’s new identity in Him. It is a public confession that we belong to Jesus.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: It signifies union with Christ and entrance into visible discipleship.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Its meaning is rooted in the Gospel, not in human performance.
